title: Improving Followup of Abnormal Colon Cancer Screening Tests
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether direct mailings to patients with positive fecal occult blood tests can increase rates of performing followup colonoscopy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with positive fecal occult blood test during 2004, 2005, and 2006; and no colonoscopy following this test result

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with active cardiopulmonary disease or limited life expectancy due to severe illness such as malignancy
* Colonoscopy within 5 years prior to positive fecal occult blood test
* Age \> 80 years
